scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Port Malaya^000000, the Breathing Village.
Where cultures and legends come to life!
Do you need help navigating the village?
scripts.translation:
[馬來港嚮導]
歡迎來到充滿生機的村莊^8B4513馬來港^000000。
這裡的文化與傳說鮮活生動！
需要我為您指引方向嗎？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Guide]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[馬來港導覽員]
點選^B9062F[地點名稱]^000000，便可享受最先進的^B9062F導航^000000服務！
